The '''Lobaoc system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]]. It contained the [[Water/Legends|watery]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lobaoc]]. At some point between [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Jedi Consular]] and [[Jedi investigator/Legends|investigator]] [[Ambaln]] was sent by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to Lobaoc to bring a native [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Unidentified Human female (Lobaoc)|girl]] back for [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]]. Unbeknownst to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], Ambaln had previously fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and the council subsequently dispatched a group of individuals to the planet in order to apprehend the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Description==
The Lobaoc [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lobaoc]], a [[Water/Legends|watery]] world of lakes and [[Swamp/Legends|marshes]].<ref name="Wizards" />

==History==
At some point between [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">"[[Swim Meet]]" is set in the [[Rise of the Empire era]], which the [[Wookieepedia:The Star Wars Legends Novels Timeline|''Star Wars'' Legends Novels Timeline]] dates to between [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. In addition, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]&mdash;which, along with the rest of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], was disbanded in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''&mdash;is extant during the events of the adventure; therefore, "Swim Meet" must be set at some point between 67 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and 19 BBY.</ref> the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] learned of the existence of a young [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Unidentified Human female (Lobaoc)|girl]] on Lobaoc who had potential for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. To appraise the situation and bring the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|potential Jedi]] back for training, the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] dispatched the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi Consular]] and [[Jedi investigator/Legends|investigator]] [[Ambaln]] to Lobaoc. However, after the investigator had already departed on his [[Mission to Lobaoc|mission]], the Council realized that Ambaln, whose prior assignment had been as a deep undercover operative within a criminal syndicate, had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. To bring Ambaln back to the Jedi Order for rehabilitation, the Council then also sent a group of individuals to Lobaoc.<ref name="Wizards" />

{{RPG|"[[Swim Meet]]"}}
Ambaln traveled to Lobaoc in his [[Whitecloak fighter]] and convinced the [[Gender/Legends|girl's]] [[Glirin family|parents]] to give up their [[Youngling/Legends|child]] for Jedi training. Ambaln then waited for the arrival of the group sent by the Jedi Council and lured the individuals into an attack by the local [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] creatures. Using the attack as a distraction, Ambaln eventually escaped to his [[Starfighter/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Wizards" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
Lobaoc featured a number of settlements inhabited by [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Near-Human]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]]. One such settlement was [[Koab]], a village with a population of a few thousand individuals.<ref name="Wizards" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lobaoc system was introduced via an appearance of the planet Lobaoc in "[[Swim Meet]]," a ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' mini-adventure authored by [[Jeff Quick]] and published on the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Wizards.com|website]] on [[August 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="Wizards" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' identified the [[Star/Legends|star system]] and placed it in grid square N-3.<ref name="TEA" />

In "Swim Meet," the scenario for the player characters' encounter with Ambaln on Lobaoc is left open-ended. If Ambaln escapes the characters, the Mon Calamari swims back to his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and leaves Lobaoc. The fallen Jedi then spends a few [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] staying hidden before returning to Lobaoc with the young girl to begin her [[The Force/Legends|Force]] training. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="Wizards" />
